meta_note: All dates are in UTC ISO 8601 format. User authentication is required for all endpoints. all routes are prefixed with /api/.

payment_subscribeUser.description: Create a Paystack Checkout session URL for upgrading the authenticated user to the PRO plan.

payment_startTrial.description: Start the 2-month free Pro trial. Initializes a ₦50 card-verification charge via Paystack and returns the hosted payment URL. The user must complete the card capture on Paystack's page. On charge.success the gateway webhook creates the future-dated subscription, stores encrypted tokens, records the abuse-guard row, and refunds the ₦50. Each email address can only claim one trial — the guard survives account deletion.

data.checkoutSessionUrl: string — Paystack hosted payment URL; redirect the user here

responses.409: Trial already used for this email address

payment_createPortalSession.description: Create a Payatstack billing portal URL for the authenticated user to manage billing and subscription settings.

payment_cancelSubscription.description: Disable auto-renewal on the authenticated user's active Paystack subscription. The user retains Pro access until paystackCurrentPeriodEnd — the daily scheduler sweep handles the actual downgrade to FREE at period end. Triggers a subscription.disable or subscription.not_renew webhook from Paystack which the gateway records.

responses.200: Cancellation scheduled — Pro access continues until period end

payment_resumeSubscription.description: Re-enable auto-renewal on a previously cancelled subscription. Only effective while the subscription is still within its current billing period (before paystackCurrentPeriodEnd). Paystack does not fire a webhook on re-enable; next billing confirmation comes via invoice.create.

payment_webhook.description: Receive Paystack webhook events and process subscription/invoice lifecycle updates.
